To substitute cream cheese in a classic cheesecake while maintaining the original flavor and structure, you can use mascarpone cheese. Mascarpone has a similar high fat content and creamy texture, which helps preserve the rich mouthfeel of the dessert. For the best results, blend mascarpone with a small amount of sour cream or Greek yogurt to add the slight tanginess that cream cheese provides. Another option is a mixture of full-fat cottage cheese or ricotta cheese that has been thoroughly blended until smooth, though this may result in a slightly grainier texture unless processed extensively.
